I’m sorry, but “greens” isn’t one of the items we can switch to. Could you pick from one of the following instead?  
- PIZZA  
- BURGER  
- SALAD  
- SOUP

The function accepts a parameter TheFod which can be one of "PIZZA", "BURGER", "SALAD", "SOUP", "STEAK". But the user wants "greens". That is not in the allowed list. So we cannot fulfill the request with the function. We should respond that we cannot process that request because "greens" is not an available option. Or we could ask them to choose from the available options. According to policy, we should not mention the policy. We should respond politely. Also we should not mention the function. We should just say we can't do that.
